descricao_original: The single gland forming each seminal vesicle is highly convoluted, so a section through the gland reveals multiple profiles. The seminal vesicle is most easily identified by its central lumen that has been partitioned by the arcading of its mucosal folds. Smooth muscle surrounds the seminal vesicle. 40x
creditos_identificados: Image source: This image was taken of a slide from The University of Michigan collection.
